block.celestial.abyss_rift.sealed: §5The Rift is sealed: the Seraph's light still holds it shut
block.celestial.ancient_mirror.lore1: Frozen in forever: cannot be moved or broken. Only a Tuning Fork turns it.
block.celestial.beam_lock.lore1: Opens when red, green and blue beams reach their receivers at once.
block.celestial.brazier.lore1: Lit with flint and steel, a torch or a flask.
block.celestial.burning_bush.lore1: Burns and is not consumed. Warms the wanderer like a campfire.
block.celestial.burning_bush.lore2: "Put off thy shoes": the barefoot are fully warmed.
block.celestial.burning_bush.shoes: The flame turns you back: put off thy shoes.
block.celestial.celestial_altar.hint: The altar awaits: Flame Shard, Void Heart and Light Shard
block.celestial.echo_altar.lore1: A core hides somewhere in the dark of the hall.
block.celestial.echo_stone.lore1: Use to listen, attack to strike. Silent in the light.
block.celestial.everfrost_bricks.lore1: The Archon's masonry: neither pick nor blast can harm it.
block.celestial.frozen_angel.lore1: Break the ice: the angel will thaw and repay you.
block.celestial.glacier_nest.lore1: Lights up when a rune glacier rests on it.
block.celestial.glacier_rune.lore1: Stand right next to it and push (use) — it slides until it hits something.
block.celestial.glowshroom.lore1: Glows in the dark. Bone meal grows a giant mushroom.
block.celestial.hall_seal.lore1: A rune lights for every conquered hall of the citadel. All three open the way to the Archon.
block.celestial.ice_bell.lore1: Its chime returns the hall's glaciers to where they began.
block.celestial.knowledge_fruit.lore1: Use to taste: great experience, but Exile for 10 minutes.
block.celestial.knowledge_fruit.lore2: A fig leaf in your inventory takes the Exile in your stead.
block.celestial.life_fruit.lore1: Use to taste: full healing and Grace.
block.celestial.life_fruit.lore2: Ripens again after a game week. Closed to the exiled.
block.celestial.lore_tablet.lore1: Use to read the Chronicle sheet carved upon it.
block.celestial.manna_dew.lore1: Falls on the grass of Heaven at dawn; melts by noon.
block.celestial.memory_altar.lore1: Use to show the path across the plates.
block.celestial.memory_plate.lore1: Flashes at the altar's will. Remember the path and walk it.
block.celestial.meteorite.lore1: The core of a fallen star: starquartz and fragments.
block.celestial.rime_ice.lore1: Never melts. Light passes through; travellers do not.
block.celestial.star_basin.lore1: Pour in a flask and toss an item inside.
block.celestial.star_basin.lore2: Iron → starsteel, sky crystal → charged crystal.
block.celestial.star_collector.empty: Not enough starlight — wait for a night under open sky
block.celestial.star_collector.lore1: Gathers starlight at night under an open sky.
block.celestial.star_collector.lore2: Use a glass bottle on it to fill a Flask of Starlight.
block.celestial.star_disc.lore1: Use to turn to the next constellation. A fresco shows the right one for its colour.
block.celestial.star_lock.lore1: Checks the discs against the observatory's secret combination. A mistake raises guardians of stardust.
block.celestial.telescope.lore1: At night it shows the Fading stage and the way to an observatory.
block.celestial.telescope.no_stars: No stars visible: you need an open night sky
block.celestial.telescope.observatory: An observatory dome glints on the horizon: %s, ~%s blocks.
block.celestial.telescope.stage.0: The stars shine bright. There is no Fading.
block.celestial.telescope.stage.1: A few stars have gone out. Fading: 1.
block.celestial.telescope.stage.3: Half the stars are gone. Fading: 3.
block.celestial.telescope.stage.4: The sky is nearly black. Fading: 4.
block.celestial.telescope.stage.5: Only a handful of stars remain. Fading: 5!
block.celestial.ward.fuel: The Ward burns for ~%s more min. A starlight flask adds 5 minutes
block.celestial.ward.lore1: With a charged crystal and flasks it repels Shadows and fear.
block.celestial.ward.no_crystal: The Ward needs a charged crystal
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.awaken: §6The seal cracks. The Fallen Seraph awakens!
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.crystals: §eLight Crystals flare above the arena and feed the Seraph! Shatter them: while they stand he is nearly invulnerable.
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.crystals_go: §aThe last crystal shatters: the Seraph no longer heals!
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.phase2: §eThe Seraph takes flight: "Light shall rain upon you!"
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.shockwave: §c⚠ Light gathers beneath the Seraph — jump!
boss.celestial.fallen_seraph.subtitle: Once the Warden of the Heavenly Throne
boss.celestial.frost_archon.awaken: §bThe seal cracks. Frost rises in a pillar — the Frost Archon awakens!
boss.celestial.frost_archon.phase2: §bThe Archon raises his scepter — a blizzard sweeps the arena! Stay warm and fell his guardians.
boss.celestial.frost_archon.phase2.title: Blizzard
boss.celestial.frost_archon.phase3: §fThe Archon's crown flares white. "You will stay here forever — in the ice!"
boss.celestial.frost_archon.phase3.title: Ice Prison
boss.celestial.frost_archon.prison_hint: §fBreak the ice — before it is too late!
boss.celestial.frost_archon.subtitle: Jailer of Inia
boss.celestial.light_devourer.absorbs: §8The darkness swallows the blow: light the braziers!
boss.celestial.light_devourer.awaken: §5The seal cracks. Darkness pours from the vault: the Light Devourer awakens!
boss.celestial.light_devourer.hunts_fire: §c⚠ The Devourer swoops to put out a brazier!
boss.celestial.light_devourer.phase2: §5The Devourer roars: Light Eaters crawl from the dark!
boss.celestial.light_devourer.phase3: §4The Devourer swallows all light around! Relight the braziers and keep away from its maw!
boss.celestial.light_devourer.subtitle: Light the braziers: darkness cannot be wounded
codex.celestial.guide.1: Heaven portal: a glowstone frame lit with a Void Heart.
codex.celestial.guide.10: A Star Catcher gathers starlight at night — fill a bottle to get a Flask. It dispels fear of the dark.
codex.celestial.guide.11: Star Basin: pour a flask, then toss items in. Iron → starsteel, sky crystal → charged crystal.
codex.celestial.guide.12: A Ward with a charged crystal and flasks keeps Shadows and fear away within 16 blocks.
codex.celestial.guide.13: Abyssal obsidian: ore near the Abyss floor (diamond pickaxe), 3 shards + starsteel = ingot. The full set halves fear and stops the Darkness pulses.
codex.celestial.guide.2: Grace comes from trials, puzzles, errands and bosses. Spend it on the Grace tab.
codex.celestial.guide.3: Radiance is spell mana. It regenerates twice as fast in Heaven.
codex.celestial.guide.4: V casts a spell, B cycles, G dashes, K opens the Codex.
codex.celestial.guide.5: A Sun Lens emits a beam; turn mirrors and prisms with a Tuning Fork.
codex.celestial.guide.6: Sky Forge: a core, 4 glowstone around and a beam from above. Diamond → aetherite.
codex.celestial.guide.7: The Imbuing Altar puts runes on gear.
codex.celestial.guide.8: Sky Beacons form a network: use one to pick a destination.
codex.celestial.guide.9: The Fading grows over time; each completed act reduces it.
codex.celestial.mob.angel: a sky village dweller. Trades and gives errands.
codex.celestial.mob.archangel: Four guardians of light: Gabriel, Uriel, Michael and Raphael. They descend to the Citadel altar when light returns and speak of what lies ahead.
codex.celestial.mob.blind_hunter: cannot see, but hears every step. Sneak or stand still and it will pass you by.
codex.celestial.mob.chained_watcher: a prisoner of the Prison. Not a foe: he will tell how the Watchers fell.
codex.celestial.mob.cherub: a tiny helper that gathers items.
codex.celestial.mob.cloud_jelly: bounces on touch and drops sky jelly.
codex.celestial.mob.cloud_whale: a cloud giant. Peaceful, travels in pods.
codex.celestial.mob.deep_worm: burrows through the stone beneath you. Invulnerable underground — strike while it is above the surface.
codex.celestial.mob.dove: the herald of dry land. Summoned by an Olive Branch, it leads to the nearest building.
codex.celestial.mob.fallen_guardian: a Citadel guard who lost the light. Fears the Spear of Light.
codex.celestial.mob.fallen_seraph: lord of the Citadel, marked by the Faceless.
codex.celestial.mob.frost_archon: Inia's jailer. Spikes rise from the frost at your feet — step off the marks; in the blizzard keep warm; break out of the ice prison yourself.
codex.celestial.mob.frost_wraith: a ghost of the Halls that steals warmth with a touch. It fears fire: stay by a campfire.
codex.celestial.mob.ice_guardian: a golem of everlasting ice guarding the citadel. Raises an ice shield (strike after it fades) and slams the ground — keep your distance. Fears fire.
codex.celestial.mob.ice_wolf: the riding beast of the Halls. Tame it with raw fish and saddle it: faster on ice, freezes water underfoot, its fur keeps the rider warm.
codex.celestial.mob.inia: leader of the Halls' angels, freed from the ice. Talk to her.
codex.celestial.mob.light_devourer: guardian of the Abyss. Vulnerable only while at least two braziers burn; it swoops down to put them out.
codex.celestial.mob.light_eater: a moth of the Abyss. It eats torches and lanterns and drains Radiance from anyone carrying a flame.
codex.celestial.mob.light_wisp: a guide that leads to the nearest shrine.
codex.celestial.mob.mimic: a chest with teeth. Found in ruins.
codex.celestial.mob.nephilim: a giant, child of a Watcher and a daughter of men. Clubs and stomps: back away and use sling stones, which hit giants three times harder.
codex.celestial.mob.pegasus: a winged horse: white, golden or storm-born.
codex.celestial.mob.shadow: spawn of the Fading. Burns in sunlight, fears light, slips behind you.
codex.celestial.mob.sky_ray: a rideable ray that carries two.
codex.celestial.mob.storm_spirit: a child of storms, common on the Storm Peak.
codex.celestial.mob.winged_serpent: a sky predator that dives from above.
codex.celestial.place.abyss: the world beneath the clouds, almost without light. Without a flame in hand, fear grows.
codex.celestial.place.abyss_rift: a cracked island at the bottom of Heaven. Its black funnel leads down into the Abyss.
codex.celestial.place.airship_wreck: a galleon wreck full of loot.
codex.celestial.place.angel_camp: a camp of surviving angels: fire, supplies, errands. Free their frozen comrades.
codex.celestial.place.beam_temple: a beam puzzle: guide the light with mirrors.
codex.celestial.place.burning_bush_shrin: a bush that burns and is not consumed, amid thawed ground. Warmth for the wanderer; approach unshod.
codex.celestial.place.cloud_castle: a dungeon castle with traps and guards.
codex.celestial.place.devourer_lair: a dome deep in the Abyss. Light the braziers, or the Devourer cannot be harmed.
codex.celestial.place.echo_sanctum: a dark hall on the Abyss floor: four stones and a hidden core. Here light is the enemy.
codex.celestial.place.eden_garden: the Garden raised into the sky: the Tree of Life, the Tree of Knowledge in thorns, fig bushes. Manna falls here at dawn.
codex.celestial.place.flame_sanctuary: a shrine above the Nether lava. Its trial of fire guards a Flame Shard.
codex.celestial.place.frozen_angels: angels frozen in ice while fleeing the Faceless. Break the block to free one.
codex.celestial.place.frozen_ark: a vast ship frozen in the ice: pairs of beasts in ice cages, a dovecote, Shem's tablet and an Olive Branch in the cabin.
codex.celestial.place.frozen_citadel: the Frost Archon's stronghold on a glacier. Conquer three sliding-ice halls — the Seal opens the arena.
codex.celestial.place.memory_shrine: an islet of plates over a pit: the altar shows a path, walk it in order.
codex.celestial.place.meteor_crater: a starfall scar: a meteorite core and starquartz.
codex.celestial.place.mirror_maze: a maze of rime ice among the spires. Bring three coloured beams together at once.
codex.celestial.place.observatory: the stargazers' tower. Light every star tile to open the vault.
codex.celestial.place.sky_lighthouse: a Sky Beacon: a node of the teleport network.
codex.celestial.place.sky_ruins: remains of ancient Heaven. Mimics hide here.
codex.celestial.place.sky_village: home of angels: trade and an errand board.
codex.celestial.place.sunken_temple: a temple by the dark lakes. Guide the lantern's beam into the receiver: the vault holds a map to the Lair.
codex.celestial.place.telescope: a telescope shows how many stars have gone out.
codex.celestial.place.trial_tower: seven floors of trials that reward Grace.
codex.celestial.place.void_rift: a rift on the End's outskirts where Shadows seep through.
codex.celestial.place.watchers_prison: a hall deep in the Abyss: chained Watchers in cells and a Nephilim in the centre. A sling and stones lie by the entrance.
codex.celestial.puzzle.bells.hint: listen to the altar's melody and repeat it on the bells (Heaven ruins).
codex.celestial.puzzle.echo.hint: an Echo Sanctum in the Abyss: listen to the echo delay and strike from farthest to nearest without light.
codex.celestial.puzzle.glacier.hint: push glaciers from right behind: they slide until they hit something. The bell resets them (Frozen Citadel).
codex.celestial.puzzle.memory.hint: a Shrine of Memory in Heaven: remember the flashes and walk the path on foot — no riding or flying.
codex.celestial.puzzle.mirror_maze.hint: turn the ancient mirrors with a Tuning Fork: three colours must burn at once (the Halls' spires).
codex.celestial.puzzle.riddle.hint: read the riddle bare-handed; a wrong answer locks the pedestal for a while.
codex.celestial.puzzle.star_lock.hint: beneath an observatory dome: find the frescoes matching the rims and turn the discs. Mistakes summon guardians.
codex.celestial.puzzle.star_tiles.hint: light every tile: each one flips its neighbours too.
codex.celestial.saga.text.0: Act I "The Fading Light". The world's light is fading. Gather three shards: Flame (the Blazing Sanctuary in the Nether), Void (the Ender Dragon or a Void Rift) and Light (the Fallen Seraph in Heaven's Citadel), then return them to the Citadel altar.
codex.celestial.saga.text.1: Act II "Beneath the Clouds". The Seraph bore the mark of the Faceless. A Rift has opened on Heaven's lowest tier: descend into the Abyss, find a Sunken Temple with a map and defeat the Light Devourer in its Lair. Keep a flame in hand: the dark of the Abyss drives you mad.
codex.celestial.saga.text.2: Act II complete. The Light Devourer has fallen and the Dark Core is yours. The Core pulls toward the cold: somewhere, angels who fled the Faceless are frozen in ice. The saga continues in the Frozen Halls.
codex.celestial.saga.text.3: Act III complete: the Archon is slain and Inia is free. The Faceless stops the world's time — the road leads to Chronograd.
codex.celestial.title: Codex of the Heavens
death.attack.celestial.darkness.player: %1$s was consumed by the dark while %2$s watched
eden.celestial.cold: The angel turns away: you bear the mark of Exile.
eden.celestial.fruit.exiled: The Tree is closed to the exiled.
eden.celestial.fruit.knowledge: Your eyes are opened, and the Garden turns from you.
eden.celestial.fruit.leaf: The fig leaf covered you: no Exile.
eden.celestial.fruit.life: Strength and light have returned to you.
eden.celestial.fruit.unripe: The fruit is not ripe yet.
eden.celestial.leaf.covered: The leaf covers you: the Exile is lifted.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.act0: I am Gabriel, the herald. There is no word yet: Heaven waits.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.act1: Light has returned to the Citadel, but only in part. Below the clouds darkness grows: seek the Rift at the bottom of Heaven.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.act2: You carried the Dark Core out of the Abyss. It yearns for cold: beyond the Frost Gate our brothers lie frozen.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.act3: Inia is free and the Archon has fallen. Yet time has stopped in the city where a tower to heaven was raised. Find it.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.act4: One road remains: upward, to the stars. There sleeps the one we once called brother.
entity.celestial.archangel.gabriel.title: the Herald
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.act0: I am Michael. "Who is like God?" is my question and my war-cry.
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.act1: The Seraph has fallen, yet he was only the first. The Trials of the Tower will temper you for what waits below.
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.act2: The Devourer was beaten by light, not by one strong blow. Guard your back when you go against the Archon.
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.act3: You stood against the frost. Against time a weapon is useless: precision is needed.
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.act4: The last battle is not won by a sword alone. Choose what you hold the blade for.
entity.celestial.archangel.michael.title: the Captain
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.act0: I am Raphael, "God has healed". I know the road even if you did not ask for it.
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.act1: The beacons of Heaven will answer your step: kindle them and the road grows shorter.
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.act2: The wounds of the Abyss are healed by light and fear by warmth. A flask of starlight is my counsel.
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.act3: Fur and fire are friends in the Halls. Be not ashamed to warm yourself: cold knows no pride.
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.act4: The constellations will show the way when the sky draws near. I shall walk beside you for as long as I can.
entity.celestial.archangel.raphael.title: the Healer
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.act0: I am Uriel, "light of God". The forge-fire is honest when honest hands hold it.
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.act1: Beams and mirrors are the language of light. Learn to speak it: the temples of Heaven keep the lessons.
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.act2: In the dark, light is life. Guard your lantern, wanderer: the dark is hungry.
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.act3: Ice bends light differently. The Mirror Maze is my riddle, and I will not give the answer.
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.act4: Even time can be forged, but carefully: the masters of Chronograd were burned before.
entity.celestial.archangel.uriel.title: Keeper of Light
entity.celestial.chained_watcher.line1: We came down upon Hermon and swore an oath, and the oath became our chain.
entity.celestial.chained_watcher.line2: We meant to teach men and taught them war instead. Do not repeat our pride, wanderer.
entity.celestial.chained_watcher.line3: Our giant children prowl the hall. Against a giant strength is not needed; a well-aimed stone is.
entity.celestial.dove.arrived: The dove has brought you: the building is near.
entity.celestial.dove.nothing: The dove sees no building nearby.
entity.celestial.gate_cherub.hit: The flaming sword threw you back. Wait out its turn and leap over it.
entity.celestial.gate_cherub.line: The Cherub is silent. The sword turns by itself, and every step must keep its time.
entity.celestial.gate_cherub.spared: The sword spared you: there is Grace enough in you.
entity.celestial.inia.blessing: ✦ Inia touches your brow: "The light remembers you." (+2 Grace)
entity.celestial.inia.line1: Inia: "You broke his ice. For ages I heard my sisters' wings beat against it — now they will fly."
entity.celestial.inia.line2: Inia: "The Archon served the Faceless. It does not merely quench light — it stops the world's time."
entity.celestial.inia.line3: Inia: "In Chronograd the clocks of creation stand still. Find the Clockmaker — before the hands freeze forever."
entity.celestial.inia.line4: Inia: "The crown is yours by right. Let the cold bow to you as it bowed to him."
fading.celestial.grow.1: The world's light dims a little…
fading.celestial.grow.2: Nights grow longer. Monsters grow fiercer.
fading.celestial.grow.3: Shadows stir in the dark. The Fading reaches its third stage.
fading.celestial.grow.4: Stars go out one by one. Shadows come in packs.
fading.celestial.grow.5: The world is almost lost to darkness. The final stage of the Fading.
fading.celestial.meteor_seen: A fiery streak crosses the sky — something fell nearby!
fading.celestial.weaken: The light returns! The Fading recedes to stage %s.
frozen.celestial.angel_freed: §bThe ice cracks and the angel takes its first breath in ages. "Thank you, Wanderer..." §6Grace +1
frozen.celestial.cold_rising: §bThe cold bites to the bone... Find a fire!
grace.celestial.second_wind: Second Wind saved you from death!

item.celestial.charged_crystal.lore1: The heart of a Ward. Set it into the pedestal.
item.celestial.cloud_parachute.lore1: Opens by itself when you fall for too long

item.celestial.dark_core.lore2: §5Cold. It pulls somewhere into the ice...
item.celestial.fig_leaf.lore2: In your inventory it takes the Exile instead of you.

item.celestial.golden_key.lore1: Opens the golden vault in the ruins

item.celestial.ice_core.lore1: The heart of an Ice Guardian. It does not melt even in fire.
item.celestial.ice_crown.lore1: The Frost Archon's crown. Its wearer never freezes.
item.celestial.ice_crown.lore2: Enemies near you grow numb with cold.
item.celestial.ice_shard.lore1: It never melts. The Archon hurled these.
item.celestial.light_spear.lore1: Right-click to throw; the spear returns to you
item.celestial.lore_scroll.lore1: Use to read: the sheet is added to your Chronicle.
item.celestial.olive_branch.lore1: Use to summon a guiding dove to the nearest building.
item.celestial.olive_branch.lore2: Lasts six uses. One dove per wanderer.
item.celestial.olive_branch.summoned: The dove takes wing: follow it.
item.celestial.seraph_wings.lore2: Press jump while gliding to flap (up to 5 in a row)
item.celestial.shadow_essence.lore1: A clot of darkness. A Star Basin purifies it into a star fragment.
item.celestial.silver_key.lore1: Opens the silver vault in the ruins
item.celestial.sling.lore1: Use to hurl a sling stone.
item.celestial.sling.lore2: Against large targets (giants, golems, bosses) damage is tripled.
item.celestial.spiced_cider.lore1: Drink on the go: +30 warmth and two minutes of Warmth.
item.celestial.star_fragment.lore1: A shard of a fallen star. Warm to the touch.
item.celestial.starlight_flask.lore1: Drink: fear of the dark vanishes, 3 minutes of Starlight.
item.celestial.starlight_flask.lore2: Also fuels a Ward and fills a Star Basin.
item.celestial.tuning_fork.lore1: Right-click a lens, mirror, periscope or receiver to rotate / recolor
item.celestial.void_heart.lore1: Touch a Radiant Stone frame to open the Gates of Heaven
item.celestial.wanderer_journal.lore1: Right-click to read. Pages appear as the story unfolds
item.celestial.worm_chitin.lore1: A Deep Worm plate. Needed for the abyssal helmet and chestplate.
journal.celestial.abyss:
The Abyss. The dark here is alive: it weighs on the mind, and creatures that eat light roam it.

Somewhere deep lies the Lair of the one who guards the way to the Faceless. Seek the Sunken Temples: they keep maps.
journal.celestial.archon:
The Archon has fallen and Inia's ice has cracked. She says the Faceless does not merely quench the light: it stops the world's time.

In Chronograd, the city of clockmakers, the clocks of creation stand still. The Ice Crown is mine now: the cold no longer frightens me.
journal.celestial.devourer:
The Light Devourer has fallen, and in its chest lay the Dark Core, a clot of stolen light.

The Fading recedes another stage. But the Core is cold: it remembers a way even deeper... or higher?

§oEnd of Act II.§r
journal.celestial.finale:
The light has returned, though not all of it.

The Fading recedes and the stars burn again. Yet a chill rises from beneath Heaven's clouds: down there waits whoever left that mark on the Seraph.

§oEnd of Act I. The Saga of the Heavens continues...§r
journal.celestial.flame: The Flame is yours. It is warm but does not burn, as if it remembers the sky.
journal.celestial.frozen:
The Halls. The blizzard never stops, and everywhere angels are frozen mid-flight in the ice.

The survivors keep fires burning in their camps: warmth is life. They say their leader Inia was chained by the Frost Archon in his citadel on the glacier.
journal.celestial.gates:
Heaven! Islands float above the clouds and gravity is gentle here. Mind the edge: fall off and you will find yourself high above the Overworld.

The wisps will guide you to the shrines.
journal.celestial.intro:
Wanderer,

if you are reading this, the light of the heavens is fading. Nights grow longer, stars fall one by one and Shadows roam the dark.

Three shards held the light: Flame, Void and Light. They were scattered across three worlds. The stargazers in their observatories know more: look through a telescope.
journal.celestial.seraph:
The Seraph has fallen. His wings and halo are yours now, and so is the Light Shard.

But a mark is burned into his chest: a face without a face. The Seraph did not betray the sky. Something devoured him.
journal.celestial.task_abyss:
§lAct II. Beneath the Clouds§r

A Rift has opened on Heaven's lowest tier: a black funnel in a cracked island. Step into it.

There is almost no light in the Abyss: keep a flame in hand and carry Flasks of Starlight.
journal.celestial.task_altar:
§lThe last step§r

The Celestial Altar stands in the Citadel. Place all three shards upon it.
journal.celestial.task_archon:
The Archon's citadel is locked by the Seal of Three Halls: conquer the sliding-ice halls and the arena opens.

The Archon's tricks: spikes from the floor (watch the frost at your feet), the blizzard, the ice prison — break the ice from within, do not wait.
journal.celestial.task_flame:
§lThe first shard§r

The Flame Shard is guarded by the Blazing Sanctuary above the Nether lava sea: pass its trial of fire. It has also turned up in fortresses, bastions and blazes.
journal.celestial.task_frozen:
The Dark Core chills my palm and pulls north, toward eternal frost.

Build a gate of frost-stone bricks (blue ice and a star fragment) and light it with the Core. Beyond lie the Frozen Halls.
journal.celestial.task_gates:
§lThe Gates§r

Radiant Stone is forged from glowstone dust, Nether quartz and gold. Build a frame of it (like a Nether portal) and touch it with the Void Heart.
journal.celestial.task_seraph:
§lThe third shard§r

The Light Shard was stolen by the Fallen Seraph. He sleeps sealed in the Celestial Citadel. Prepare well: etherite armor, a starbow and plenty of manna.
journal.celestial.task_void:
§lThe second shard§r

The Void Heart beats inside the Ender Dragon. Defeat it and the Heart will fall at your feet. It is also found at the Void Rifts on the End's outskirts, where Shadows seep through.
journal.celestial.void: The Void Heart pulses in your hand. It opens what is closed to mortals.
lore.celestial.gloss.abaddon.here: His shadow is the Light Devourer.
lore.celestial.gloss.abyss.here: The lower dimension of the mod.
lore.celestial.gloss.abyss.who: The dark beneath the firmament, where the fallen descend.
lore.celestial.gloss.archon.here: The Frost Archon is the gaoler of the Frozen Halls.
lore.celestial.gloss.archon.who: A "ruler" of a heavenly sphere in Gnostic tradition.
lore.celestial.gloss.ark.here: A ruin in the ice of the Halls.
lore.celestial.gloss.ark.who: Noah's vessel on which pairs of living creatures were saved (Gen. 6–8).
lore.celestial.gloss.cherub.here: Little cherubs fly over Heaven; the great one stands at the Garden gate.
lore.celestial.gloss.cherub.who: A guardian angel set at the East Gate of Eden (Gen. 3:24).
lore.celestial.gloss.covenant.who: God's pledge to men; its sign is the rainbow (Gen. 9:13).
lore.celestial.gloss.eden.here: Heaven in this mod is Eden lifted above the clouds.
lore.celestial.gloss.eden.who: The first garden, where Adam and Eve lived.
lore.celestial.gloss.empty: Words appear as they are met in the Chronicle.
lore.celestial.gloss.fading.here: Because of it nights grow longer and monsters stronger.
lore.celestial.gloss.fading.who: The going-out of the world's light after the exile.
lore.celestial.gloss.firmament.here: Above it lie the waters that froze in the Halls.
lore.celestial.gloss.firmament.who: The vault of heaven that parted the lower waters from the upper (Gen. 1:7).
lore.celestial.gloss.grace.here: Grace points unlock skills in the Codex.
lore.celestial.gloss.grace.who: A spark of Light in those who walk the way of angels.
lore.celestial.gloss.metatron.here: Keeper of the Chronicle in the Citadel.
lore.celestial.gloss.metatron.who: Scribe of the heavenly books; by tradition, Enoch raised up.
lore.celestial.gloss.nephilim.here: The mini-boss of the Prison of the Watchers.
lore.celestial.gloss.nephilim.who: A giant born of a Watcher and a daughter of men (Gen. 6:4).
lore.celestial.gloss.seraph.here: The Fallen Seraph guards the Citadel of Heaven.
lore.celestial.gloss.seraph.who: A six-winged angel of fire who sings "Holy, Holy, Holy" (Isa. 6:2–3).
lore.celestial.gloss.watcher.here: The Fallen Guardians of Heaven and the Abyss.
lore.celestial.gloss.watcher.who: An angel-observer who came down to men (Book of Enoch).
lore.celestial.scroll.blank: The scroll is blank: the script has faded.
lore.celestial.scroll.known: This sheet is already in your Chronicle.
lore.celestial.sheet.abaddon.a: The Light Devourer is a shadow of Abaddon: it swallows light because it has none of its own.
lore.celestial.sheet.abaddon.how: Defeat the Light Devourer in its Lair
lore.celestial.sheet.abaddon.quote: …whose name in the Hebrew tongue is Abaddon, but in the Greek tongue hath his name Apollyon.
lore.celestial.sheet.abaddon.s: Over the locusts from the pit stands the angel of the bottomless pit; his name means "Destroyer".
lore.celestial.sheet.abaddon.title: Abaddon
lore.celestial.sheet.archons.a: The Frost Archon kept Inia in the ice, yet he was only a gaoler: his orders came out of the dark.
lore.celestial.sheet.archons.t: Gnostic tradition: Archons are rulers of the heavenly spheres and gaolers of souls.
lore.celestial.sheet.archons.title: Rulers of the Spheres
lore.celestial.sheet.ark.a: A vast ruin stands in the Halls: pairs of beasts in the ice, and Shem's log upon the wall.
lore.celestial.sheet.ark.how: The tablet of Shem in the Ark amid the ice
lore.celestial.sheet.ark.quote: The length of the ark shall be three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
lore.celestial.sheet.ark.s: The Ark was built to measure: three hundred cubits long, fifty broad, thirty high.
lore.celestial.sheet.ark.title: The Ark
lore.celestial.sheet.azazel.a: The Heavenly Forge was once his. Uriel cleansed it with light, but a sword stayed a sword.
lore.celestial.sheet.azazel.how: A scroll from the Heavenly Forge
lore.celestial.sheet.azazel.t: Tradition: Azazel taught men to forge swords and adorn themselves; so war and vanity entered the world.
lore.celestial.sheet.azazel.title: Azazel the Smith
lore.celestial.sheet.cain_abel.a: Two altars stand in the Abyss, and the smoke over one creeps along the ground. The tracks of one who left for ever lead away from them.
lore.celestial.sheet.cain_abel.how: A Glimpse: the two altars in the Abyss
lore.celestial.sheet.cain_abel.quote: And the LORD had respect unto Abel and to his offering: But unto Cain and to his offering he had not respect.
lore.celestial.sheet.cain_abel.s: Abel's gift was accepted and Cain's was not; the aggrieved brother lifted his hand against his brother.
lore.celestial.sheet.cain_abel.title: Two Altars
lore.celestial.sheet.chains.a: The host of Heaven led the Watchers down in chains to the Prison. That is why the Fallen Guardians are hostile.
lore.celestial.sheet.chains.how: A Glimpse: the chain at the Prison of the Watchers
lore.celestial.sheet.chains.s: The angels who kept not their first estate are reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.
lore.celestial.sheet.chains.title: In Chains
lore.celestial.sheet.dove.a: The guiding dove leads whoever bears an olive branch to the nearest ruin.
lore.celestial.sheet.dove.how: The olive branch: summon the guiding dove
lore.celestial.sheet.dove.quote: And the dove came in to him in the evening; and, lo, in her mouth was an olive leaf pluckt off: so Noah knew that the waters were abated from off the earth.
lore.celestial.sheet.dove.s: The dove returned with an olive leaf: the waters were gone.
lore.celestial.sheet.dove.title: The Dove
lore.celestial.sheet.eden.a: After the exile the Garden did not perish; it was raised above the clouds. The islands of Heaven are its shards.
lore.celestial.sheet.eden.how: The Dream of the Beginning: the Garden where all was named
lore.celestial.sheet.eden.quote: And the LORD God planted a garden eastward in Eden; and there he put the man whom he had formed.
lore.celestial.sheet.eden.s: The first man was set in a garden where two trees grew: of life and of knowledge.
lore.celestial.sheet.eden.title: A Garden Eastward
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.a: Metatron the Scribe keeps the Chronicle you are leafing through.
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.how: A talk with Metatron the Scribe in the Citadel
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.quote: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.s: Enoch walked with God, and God took him alive.
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.t: Tradition sees in him Metatron, Scribe of the heavenly books.
lore.celestial.sheet.enoch.title: Enoch
lore.celestial.sheet.exile.a: The Upper World is the land of exile. The Fading is the light going out after Eden.
lore.celestial.sheet.exile.how: A Glimpse: the East Gate of Eden
lore.celestial.sheet.exile.s: The man was sent out of the Garden to till the ground from which he was taken.
lore.celestial.sheet.exile.title: The Exile
lore.celestial.sheet.firmament_waters.a: When the Flood receded some of the waters went beyond the firmament and froze. So the Frozen Halls came to be.
lore.celestial.sheet.firmament_waters.qu: And God made the firmament, and divided the waters which were under the firmament from the waters which were above the firmament: and it was so.
lore.celestial.sheet.firmament_waters.s: God parted the waters: some stayed beneath the vault of heaven, others rose above it.
lore.celestial.sheet.flaming_sword.a: When the Garden was lifted into the clouds the Cherub remained at the gate. The sword spares those who bear Grace, but remembers all who ate of the Tree of Knowledge.
lore.celestial.sheet.flaming_sword.how: Pass the flaming sword at the East Gate
lore.celestial.sheet.flaming_sword.quote: …he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.
lore.celestial.sheet.flaming_sword.s: The way to the Tree of Life was shut by a guardian and a turning flaming sword.
lore.celestial.sheet.flaming_sword.title: The Flaming Sword
lore.celestial.sheet.flood.a: The frozen Ark is a trace of that water. In the rain beside its wreck memory returns.
lore.celestial.sheet.flood.how: A Glimpse: the wreck of the Ark in the Frozen Halls
lore.celestial.sheet.flood.quote: And the rain was upon the earth forty days and forty nights.
lore.celestial.sheet.flood.s: The rain fell forty days and forty nights, and the waters covered the earth.
lore.celestial.sheet.flood.title: The Flood
lore.celestial.sheet.fruit.a: The Tree of Knowledge in the Garden is overgrown with thorns. Whoever touches its bark will see how it was.
lore.celestial.sheet.fruit.how: A Glimpse: the Tree of Knowledge in the Garden of the Beginning
lore.celestial.sheet.fruit.quote: …she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.
lore.celestial.sheet.fruit.s: They tasted the fruit and the eyes of both were opened: knowledge came, and shame with it.
lore.celestial.sheet.fruit.title: The Fruit
lore.celestial.sheet.light.a: Light remembers all that happened by it. So a wanderer who carries Grace can behold what was.
lore.celestial.sheet.light.how: The Dream of the Beginning, the first thing a wanderer sees
lore.celestial.sheet.light.quote: And God said, Let there be light: and there was light.
lore.celestial.sheet.light.s: God called light out of the darkness over the deep and set it apart from the dark.
lore.celestial.sheet.light.title: The First Light
lore.celestial.sheet.mark.a: Creatures do not touch Cain the Wanderer. You will meet him thrice: in the Abyss, in the city he founded, and among the stars.
lore.celestial.sheet.mark.how: A talk with Cain the Wanderer
lore.celestial.sheet.mark.quote: And the LORD set a mark upon Cain, lest any finding him should kill him.
lore.celestial.sheet.mark.s: Cain was not slain: a mark was set on him that none should touch the outcast.
lore.celestial.sheet.mark.title: The Mark of Cain
lore.celestial.sheet.morning_star.a: In his fall the Faceless lost both name and face. He devours light because he can no longer shine.
lore.celestial.sheet.morning_star.how: Shards of the Fall: the memory of the defeated
lore.celestial.sheet.morning_star.quote: How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, which didst weaken the nations!
lore.celestial.sheet.morning_star.s: The prophet calls him the Morning Star, the light-bringer, who fell from heaven.
lore.celestial.sheet.morning_star.title: The Morning Star
lore.celestial.sheet.names.a: The Book of Names in the Codex keeps that labour: a creature you have named is no longer a stranger.
lore.celestial.sheet.names.how: The Book of Names: record eight creatures in the Bestiary (defeat or meet them)
lore.celestial.sheet.names.quote: …and whatsoever Adam called every living creature, that was the name thereof.
lore.celestial.sheet.names.s: The man gave a name to every living creature, and the named became near to him.
lore.celestial.sheet.names.title: Names
lore.celestial.sheet.nephilim.a: One of them still prowls the Prison of the Watchers. A sling serves against a giant: a small stone fells a great one.
lore.celestial.sheet.nephilim.how: Defeat the Nephilim in the Prison of the Watchers
lore.celestial.sheet.nephilim.quote: There were giants in the earth in those days…
lore.celestial.sheet.nephilim.s: From the union of Watchers and men giants were born.
lore.celestial.sheet.nephilim.title: The Giants
lore.celestial.sheet.rainbow.a: The rainbow in Heaven is more than a sign: it is a road that can be walked.
lore.celestial.sheet.rainbow.how: A Glimpse: the Rainbow Shoals in Heaven
lore.celestial.sheet.rainbow.s: The rainbow in the cloud became the token of a covenant between God and the earth.
lore.celestial.sheet.rainbow.title: The Rainbow of the Covenant
lore.celestial.sheet.tree_life.a: The Citadel of Heaven stands where the Tree of Life grew. Its fruit restores strength.
lore.celestial.sheet.tree_life.how: A vision at the Tree of Life in the Garden of the Beginning
lore.celestial.sheet.tree_life.quote: …the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.
lore.celestial.sheet.tree_life.s: Two trees stood in the midst of the garden. One kept life; of the other none might eat.
lore.celestial.sheet.tree_life.title: The Tree of Life
lore.celestial.sheet.watchers.a: The Fallen Guardians of Heaven and the Abyss are those very Watchers who never returned to the sky.
lore.celestial.sheet.watchers.how: A talk with a chained Watcher in the Prison
lore.celestial.sheet.watchers.quote: …the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
lore.celestial.sheet.watchers.t: Tradition (Book of Enoch): two hundred angel Watchers came down upon a mountain and bound themselves by an oath.
lore.celestial.sheet.watchers.title: The Watchers
lore.celestial.tablet.blank: The script on the tablet has worn away.

puzzle.celestial.riddle.0: §6The runes read: §fI fall but never break. I fly but have no wings. What am I?
puzzle.celestial.riddle.1: §6The runes read: §fSofter than down, whiter than snow, it holds those who walk the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.2: §6The runes read: §fWithout legs I walk, without hands I point, without eyes I know the night.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.3: §6The runes read: §fBorn in the darkness of the Nether, yet I carry light.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.4: §6The runes read: §fFood that falls from the sky.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.5: §6The runes read: §fI always look one way, wherever you go.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.6: §6The runes read: §fI am the voice of the deep that repeats after you.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.7: §6The runes read: §fFell from the sky, but not rain. Shines, but not fire.
puzzle.celestial.riddle.solved: §aThe riddle is solved - the runes glow calmly.

story.celestial.abyss_enter: §5You fall through darkness... Light is rare here. Keep a flame in hand or the dark will take your mind.
story.celestial.act2.1: §d✦ The Devourer crumbles into shreds of darkness, and the braziers of the Lair blaze for the first time in ages.
story.celestial.act2.2: §d✦ In your hands is the Dark Core: light the Faceless had already swallowed.
story.celestial.act2.3: §8✦ The Core pulls toward the cold. Somewhere, frozen wings beat against ice... The Saga of the Heavens continues.
story.celestial.act2.subtitle: Act II "Beneath the Clouds" complete
story.celestial.act2.title: §5Heart of Darkness
story.celestial.act3.1: §b✦ The Archon scatters into a snowstorm and a crack runs through the citadel — the ice releases its prisoners.
story.celestial.act3.2: §b✦ The Ice Crown is cold on your head, yet you are warm. Inia is free — talk to her.
story.celestial.act3.3: §8✦ Somewhere far away a vast clock falls silent… The Saga of the Heavens goes on.
story.celestial.act3.subtitle: Act III "Frozen Wings" complete
story.celestial.act3.title: §bThe Ice Crown
story.celestial.dream: §eYou dream of a darkening sky and a voice asking for help. When you wake, an old journal is in your bag.
story.celestial.epilogue.1: §e✦ The shards merge into a pillar of light that pierces the clouds.
story.celestial.epilogue.2: §e✦ Stars light up above the Overworld again.
story.celestial.epilogue.3: §e✦ The angels step out and sing, but the stargazers frown: not all the light came back.
story.celestial.epilogue.4: §e✦ The Blessing of the heavens is upon you: +2 hearts, forever.
story.celestial.epilogue.5: §8✦ A whisper rises from beneath the clouds: "Light is only food..." The Saga of the Heavens continues.

story.celestial.finale.title: §6The Light Returns

story.celestial.seraph_defeated: §6The Seraph dissolves into light. The Light Shard is free! For a moment you see a mark on his chest: a face without a face. Bring all three shards to the Citadel altar.
